description: Show the network path from the caller to a target host on a world map: origin (the caller's IP — the user when the agent runs client-side), destination (the target's geolocation), and the great-circle distance. Returns structured endpoints plus a link to an SVG map (the image itself is for the human, not the model). Makes no connection to the target.

host.description: Target host name or IP, e.g. example.com

name: geo_route
